name: Costco Anywhere Visa® Card by Citi
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, but requiring a paid Costco membership ($65/yr or more) to hold the card at all
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment or a payment that's returned
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month, for Citi Flex Plan balances subject to a Plan Fee
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

verdict.text: Excellent if you're already a paying Costco member who drives regularly

earn_rates.category: Gas at Costco (worldwide): first $7,000/yr combined with other gas/EV charging, then 1%
Gas & EV charging elsewhere: first $7,000/yr combined with Costco gas, then 1%
Eligible travel worldwide: airfare, hotels, car rentals, travel agencies, cruise lines & Costco Travel

earn_note: The 5%/4% gas rate is capped at a combined $7,000/year in Costco + other gas/EV-charging spend (about $350 in rewards), dropping to 1% after that. Heavy drivers will hit this cap well before year-end. Timeshares, campgrounds, bed & breakfasts and train or commuter travel earn 1%, as do bakeries and restaurants inside department stores, grocery stores or warehouse clubs. Citi says the card is exclusively for Costco members, and a current Costco membership in your name is required to apply. No annual cap on the 3% or 2% categories found.

redemption_options.method: Annual reward certificate, issued once your February billing statement closes, redeemable for cash or merchandise in a single transaction at any U.S. Costco warehouse (incl. Puerto Rico) through December 31

points.per_100k: Not applicable: this is a cash-back card with no points currency; a $1,000-equivalent year of 2–5% earning becomes a roughly $20–50 certificate depending on category mix
points.note: Unlike most cash-back cards, rewards aren't a running statement credit. They accrue all year and pay out once a year as a single certificate, which you redeem for cash or merchandise in one transaction at a U.S. Costco warehouse by December 31.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: straight cash back with no points currency to move anywhere.

insurance.detail: Damage & theft · up to $1,000 per item, $50,000 per year · 120 days (90 for NY residents) · primary (secondary in NY)
Up to $50,000 · 31 consecutive days · secondary in the US, primary outside it · decline the rental company's collision coverage
Up to $250,000 per person on common carriers when the full fare is on the card, per the January 2023 Guide; Citi's current benefits list no longer names it, so confirm before relying on it

protection_note: Citi's Guide to Protection Benefits for this card covers purchase protection (up to $1,000 per item), car rental coverage (up to $50,000, secondary in the US and primary abroad) and travel accident insurance, though Citi's current benefits list no longer names the last one. No trip cancellation/interruption, baggage delay, or cell phone protection, so this isn't a substitute for a dedicated travel card on bigger trips.
rental_note: Car rental coverage applies when you decline the rental company's collision coverage and pay for the whole rental with this card. It's secondary in the US and primary outside it, up to $50,000 per rental and 31 consecutive days.

services.name: Doubles as Costco membership ID
services.detail: The card can be used to verify membership at warehouse entry while the membership is active.

services.name: Roadside assistance dispatch
services.detail: Pay-per-use dispatch in the 50 states, Washington D.C., Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands.

services.name: Free FICO Score access
services.detail: Monthly FICO Score available via Citi's online account and app.

services.name: No fee for additional cards
services.detail: Authorized users can be added at no extra cost.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)
Same purchase/rental protections as the primary card

additional_cards.note: Free to add: a natural fit for a household member who also shops at Costco, since all spend rolls into one annual certificate.

timeline.text: Card eligibility and continued use are tied to holding a paid Costco membership; this has been the structure since Citi took over the Costco co-brand portfolio from American Express in 2016.
